title: prosorus luzoniensis
intro: Prosorus luzoniensis, commonly known as Luzon prosorus, is a species of liverwort, a small, non-vascular plant that belongs to the class Marchantiophyta. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Philippines, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Prosorus luzoniensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
